contract: A first-time user can describe a campaign, review grounded channel copy, preview drafts, understand consent/provider state and find the controlled test-email action without developer terminology.

accessibility.evidence: Rendered accessibility tree exposes labeled campaign input, channel controls, approval, preview, calendar navigation and test-email field; focus styles and live status regions remain present.

responsive.evidence: Desktop uses the scannable multi-column layout; 390x844 uses single-column content and swipeable page pills without a visible scrollbar.

loading.evidence: Status text and spinner announce AI and provider work.

empty.evidence: No-task and no-audience states explain the next action.

error.evidence: Brevo rejection identifies the SMTP login/key and gives the recovery path.

partial.evidence: Campaign drafts remain reviewable while audience or providers are unavailable.

success.evidence: Draft preview confirms that nothing was sent; provider acceptance remains distinct from delivery.

permission.evidence: Bulk sends retain consent and provider gates; controlled email clearly states its one-address boundary.

renderedEvidence.observation: Guided workflow and dark-theme Marketing surface rendered with no console errors.
Single-column mobile rendering preserved readable headings and touch controls.
